name: api-katiana
description: Teste de api do projeto de conclusão de curso

scripts.k6:all-rest: npm run k6:rest-load && npm run k6:rest-stress && npm run k6:rest-spike
scripts.k6:rest-load-report: k6 run --out json=test/k6/reports/json/rest-load.json test/k6/rest/load-test.js && node test/k6/scripts/generate-html-report.js test/k6/reports/json/rest-load.json
scripts.k6:rest-stress-report: k6 run --out json=test/k6/reports/json/rest-stress.json test/k6/rest/stress-test.js && node test/k6/scripts/generate-html-report.js test/k6/reports/json/rest-stress.json
scripts.k6:rest-spike-report: k6 run --out json=test/k6/reports/json/rest-spike.json test/k6/rest/spike-test.js && node test/k6/scripts/generate-html-report.js test/k6/reports/json/rest-spike.json
